svg.title: PC-12 FLIGHT DECK CONSTRUCTION & FINISH
svg.desc: PC12-L6C rev A, AS SHOWN, A2. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
FD_CONSTRUCTION - WHAT EACH FLIGHT-DECK PART IS MADE OF
GRP shell under one stitched leather cover
black aniline leather, fine grain, satin
rolled lip R 9, double stitching 8 / 11.5 mm in
moulded composite eyebrow under the lip
RADIO-CALL plates, BARO / WARNING / CAUTION titles
Garmin PDU / SDU / GI 275 units in moulded bezels
R 2 bezel edges, corner inserts with screws
2 mm aluminium sub-panels on standoffs, 2 mm gaps
edges broken R 0.5, 45 deg tray chamfer
rocker / push / toggle switches, knurled knobs, guarded switches
white index lines / legends on caps
3 mm aluminium plate in a cast rim (PEDESTAL rim)
silk-screened scales, detents, titles, dimmer arcs
yoke column, U recess and J band
thermoformed lining panels, moulded glazing surround
rolled reveal edges with a satin bead
side consoles, CB panels on the lining
black anodised CB plates, white silk-screen
carpeted floor, footwell walls, foil blanket
MATERIALS (assemble.MATERIALS names; fit_check 36: every flight-deck material in one row)
bezel_black, display_page, screen, screen_white, screen_sky, screen_ground, lens
grip_black, black, gloss_black, rubber_black, chrome_trim, metal, metal_dark, steel, steel_dark, yoke_white, light_white
light_red, light_amber, annun_off_red, annun_off_amber, annun_off_green, annun_green, legend_lit, legend_plate, paint_red
fdb_cb_legend, fdb_cb_label, fdb_cb_glow_yellow, fdb_cb_glow_white, fdb_cb_glow_green, fdb_cb_glow_blue, psu_panel
SECTION S-S CREW CUSHION COVER AS MADE 1:1
VIEWER PILE SHELLS: TOP 9 mm OF THE PILE
CENTRE STACK PROFILE AT BL 0 WITH ITS BLENDS 1:5
PEDESTAL stack: 4 points (x, dz vs the MFD); quadrant plate STA 3.745-4.150, 300 above the floor
Drawn from model/interior.py FD_CONSTRUCTION, CREW_SEAT sheepskin_hide / sheepskin_pile and PEDESTAL rim / blend; the 3-D
builders read the same values (fd_pedestal.quadrant's rim, stack_shell's blends; seats.py's cover).
REVIEW NOTE (rev A): the cover split is a construction fact, not a shape change -- the drawn 34 mm cover and every L6B check on it are
unchanged; the pile depth only sets where the viewer's pile shells sit.
REVIEW NOTE (rev A): the rim and blend tabulate what the builders had as constants (QUAD frame 14 x 6 R 20, STACK edge_r 12) and add
the rolled top R 3 and the R 8 fillet: the rim reads as a cast part.
Printing is pad / silk-screen printing of pseudo-text (no readable markings: owner rule); in 3-D a decal 0.15 mm over its surface
Sources: [S] published data, [M] measured on the s/n 3001 photos, [E] engineering estimate.

A 2026-10-24 First issue (first-principles flight deck A4 / A6): FD_CONSTRUCTION; the sheepskin cover split into hide 4 + pile 30 (sum = CREW_SEAT sheepskin_t 34); PEDESTAL rim (14 x 6, R 20 corners, top rolled R 3) and blend (R 12 front edges, R 8 fillet into the rim).
